item.title: China, US agree to tariff cuts on $60 billion of goods including agriculture, household items
item.description: The two countries unveiled separate lists covering thousands of products as they seek to ease trade tensions and stabilize relations ahead of further negotiations. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Reuters, Financial Times, The New York Times

item.title: Stocks fall; bond market flips to 'higher for longer' mode
item.description: Treasury yields edged higher on Monday as investors look ahead to fresh economic data releases this week. [Probable] Fuentes: Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC
